ai.glance: In 19th-century Edo, the brilliant but uncredited daughter of the great artist Hokusai navigates creative passion, family duty, and the vibrant, supernatural world that inspires their art.

places.connection: The museum is dedicated to the life and works of Katsushika Hokusai, the main subject of the film.
Provides historical context of the Edo period, which is depicted in the film.
Asakusa is a historical area in Tokyo that reflects the Edo period setting of the film.
Ueno Park is a cultural hub in Tokyo, often associated with traditional Japanese art and history.
Houses a vast collection of Edo period art, similar to the artwork featured in the film.
